requirement: Recovery Time Objective must not exceed 4 hours for payment processing systems.
Recovery Time Objective must not exceed 8 hours for portfolio management systems.
All client data must be stored and processed within the European Economic Area (EEA). No transfer to third countries without explicit regulatory approval.
The bank must retain unrestricted audit and inspection rights over all ICT third-party providers supporting critical functions. Annual audit minimum.
No subcontracting of critical ICT services without prior written approval. Full transparency on the subcontracting chain required.
ICT incidents affecting service availability must be reported within 4 hours. Root cause analysis must be provided within 72 hours.
Exit strategy must guarantee full data portability within 90 days. Transition assistance period of minimum 12 months.
No single cloud provider shall host more than 60% of critical infrastructure. Multi-cloud or hybrid architecture required for critical functions.
